//: Every leg `make ci-dryrun` replays. DATA, not a list inside the Makefile recipe, so tests/contracts/test_act_dryrun_legs.py can assert the table is COMPLETE against the workflows' own declared triggers and choice options. A leg table in the recipe plus a test hardcoding the expected legs would drift, and the drift would be silent.
//why: A dry run only validates the jobs the EVENT REACHES, and a skipped job never has its `uses:` refs resolved. Measured here: workflow_dispatch target=testpypi exits 0 with a nonexistent ref planted in the release job, while a tag-push payload exits 1 and names it. One leg per event shape is the difference between a gate and a false green.
